profile.overview: Victor is a stylish Jacques of All Trades and one of the most accessible characters in the roster. With access to a good selection of solid pokes, counter hit utility, pressure moves, stance mixups, and defensive options, he is able to express any playstyle.
strengths: Counter Hit Arsenal: Access to some of the fastest, safest, and/or most effective counter hit tools in the entire game.
Strong Neutral: Excellent approach tools coupled with overall strong safe mids and good keepout tools make Victor good at controlling the neutral.
Punishing: Remarkable block & whiff punishment coupled with consistent damaging comboes and some of the best wall carry in the roster.
Iaijutsu Master: At the wall, Victor's Iai stance grants him some of the strongest okizeme and wall pressure in the game, especially during Heat.
Accessibility: Very low execution requirements as well as an overall very simple gameplan make Victor one of the most accessible characters.
Super Spy CQB: As a weapons specialist and CQB expert, Victor is one of the most difficult characters to successfully parry.
weaknesses: Poor Tracking: Most of his key moves suffer from having pretty bad tracking, requiring good timing and movement against aware opponents.
Lackluster Lows: Low attacks are mostly not rewarding enough to match the risk, and if they are rewarding at all, they are often launch punishable on block.
Old Man Recovery: Recovery is quite high overall, making whiff punishment much easier for the opponent.
Risky Defensive Options: While overall good, his defensive options are very committal and can be heavily punished if the opponent is ready to call them out.
heat: u+1+2 and IAI.d+2 get significantly better frames and additional hits
Sword moves other than u+1+2, IAI.d+2, and b,b+2+3 recover Heat on hit
